description: Follow formula references from one cell in a session, breadth first, up to depth levels (1-5): direction "precedents" walks to the cells it reads, "dependents" to the cells that read it, and "both" (the default) does each. Returns {root, direction, max_depth, levels: [{depth, nodes: [{cell, formula, value, value_type}]}]} for one direction, or precedents and dependents (each a levels list) in place of levels for "both"; ranges are expanded to single cells and each cell is listed once per direction. Use it to explain where a number comes from, find the source of an error, or see what an input affects. For a cell's own formula use get_formula_range; for the whole graph at once use inspect_model with include_edges.

cell.description: Cell reference, optionally with sheet prefix (e.g. "B4" or "Sheet1!B4")

depth.description: How many levels deep to trace (default 1, max 5)

direction.description: "precedents" for the cells this cell reads, "dependents" for the cells that read it, "both" for each (default "both")

session_id.description: Session ID returned by create_session (list_sessions shows the open ones)

name: trace_dependencies
title: Trace dependencies
